name: Intent-Preserving Query Rewriting
mechanism: Transforms conversational or underspecified input into a standalone retrieval query while preserving entities, constraints and exact identifiers.
use_when: Follow-up questions depend on conversation context
Verbose or ambiguous wording consistently lowers first-stage recall
avoid_when: Exact strings could be mutated without detection
The original query already retrieves the required evidence
expected_effects: Better retrieval alignment on measured rewrite slices
failure_modes: Semantic drift changes the requested task
Identifiers dates or negation are lost
Prompt injection is propagated into generated queries
required_evals: latency token cost and rewrite rejection rate
